'''Colorful Winter Vacation''' (Japanese: '''カラフルふゆやすみ'''  ''Karafuru Fuyuyasumi'') is one of the ending songs of the Japanese [[Pikachu short]]s.

It debuted in ''[[PK02|Christmas Night]]''.
